description: Every named list of the person whose Supabase access token is sent (Authorization: Bearer <token>; an agent API key is refused), oldest first, each with its products (newest first, the private note and the total saved at that time), and the share link when the person chose to share it. The heart's favourites are separate: list_my_favorites. Live prices: GET /api/v1/deals/products?slugs=.

locale.description: BCP 47 locale for human-readable strings, e.g. "en", "cs", "sk". Defaults to the country's default locale.

name: list_my_lists
title: The signed-in person's named lists
